evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure data quality, consistency, reliability and performance.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Data quality, reliability, testing, and documentation responsibilities dominate the JD with no velocity/speed framing present.
evidence.domain_risk: BRED IT (Thailand) Ltd. is a wholly owned subsidiary of the French bank BRED Banque Populaire
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The company is an IT subsidiary of a regulated retail bank supporting core banking systems, a default-high-risk sector even though the JD language itself is generic.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Contribute to data models, processes, technical standards and documentation
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named function code (INT-BUILD-DATA-TC), a reporting structure, and references to established processes/standards suggest a mid-maturity data function rather than greenfield or a fully specialized mature org.
evidence.jd_authorship: Develop, maintain and optimize SQL and PL/SQL scripts, procedures and database objects.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities are largely generic boilerplate (collaborate with stakeholders, contribute to knowledge sharing, participate in initiatives) that could apply to many data roles, with only SQL/PL/SQL as a specific technical anchor.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Collaborate with business users, developers, infrastructure teams and other stakeholders.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The JD names business users and infrastructure/engineering teams without clear emphasis on any single audience (commercial, product, or finance specifically), so mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: Understand business requirements and translate them into appropriate technical and data solutions.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Responsibilities describe scoped, requirement-driven work (translate requirements, maintain reports, participate in initiatives) rather than setting direction or owning strategy.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal beyond a generic mention.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is only mentioned generically ('Participate in testing, deployment, support and maintenance activities') without ownership framing or specific practice detail, closer to absent than a defined responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure data quality, consistency, reliability and performance.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: data quality and reliability are named concerns but the JD lacks explicit regulatory/compliance/audit language despite the banking-subsidiary context.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Develop and maintain reports, dashboards and data extracts according to business needs.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities are framed around maintaining, optimizing and supporting existing reports, scripts, and systems rather than building new infrastructure from scratch.
evidence.language_gate: Good command in English is a must
